messages:
Emma: tiny festive thought 1ight up a tiny corner of your desk/window and swap a handwritten mini-note or a lantern-letter. totally optional, low-effort. idea: share one small wish for next year (fun or mundane). :candle:
Raj: love this. remote folks can mail a postcard or take a photo of a hand-written note. no need for fancy stationery. :mailbox_with_mail:
Zoe: i'm in. suggestion: we do a quick 30-second show-and-tell during Friday standup + post pics here after.
Ben: logistics idea: in-office drop box + a digital uploads folder for remote. i'll organize a simple sign-up so it's not chaos. also allergy note if you include treats.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Lantern Letters & Little Wishes" Fri 4:15 PM PT 1 optional show-and-tell. RSVP by Thu 3PM.
Emma: tiny poll 1 react to this message: :sparkles: physical note, :framed_picture: photo upload, :email: e-note. react please so we know how many physical drop offs.
Raj: reacted :sparkles:. i can bring a small drop box and some stamps in case someone wants to mail on-site.
Zoe: upload link for remote folks (1-min): https://tinyurl.com/rw-lantern-letters (name + in-office/remote + upload yes/no)
Ben: in-office dropoff details (please label):
```
Drop box: 3rd floor mail nook
Drop window: Fri 9am-1pm
Label: "lantern-letter - recipient name" + sender
```
Emma: shipping tip for international: take a clear photo and upload, or send a local e-card; no need to ship internationally unless you want to. i'll compile everything into a small montage.
Raj: optional meme replacement if you don't want to write a note: one tiny wholesome meme works too. keep it PG. :blobcheer:
Zoe: i'll make a 1-slide collage and post Sunday with consent. if you'd prefer private, choose the "private" option on the upload form.
Ben: final reminder: please RSVP by Thu 3PM so i can print name tags for the drop box. thanks y'all! :sparkler:
